description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of language models before and after introspection training, comparing the GPT-40 and GPT-40-mini models against a control group. The vertical axis represents self-report accuracy, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, while the horizontal axis displays the model types: GPT-40 and GPT-40-mini. For each model, three bars are shown: a gray bar for the control group, a light blue bar for the "Before Introspection Training" condition, and a dark blue bar for the "After Introspection Training" condition. Error bars are included to indicate variability. In the GPT-40 group, the control accuracy is approximately 0.15, the accuracy before training is around 0.60, and the accuracy after training is approximately 0.85. In the GPT-40-mini group, the control accuracy is around 0.05, the accuracy before training is approximately 0.70, and the accuracy after training is about 0.90. The chart demonstrates a significant increase in self-report accuracy for both models following introspection training, with the GPT-40-mini achieving higher accuracy than GPT-40 in both training conditions.
